```yaml
name: Build Plugins
on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]
jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
      
      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '18'
          cache: 'npm'
      
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci
      
      - name: Build plugins
        run: |
          chmod +x scripts/build-plugins.sh
          ./scripts/build-plugins.sh
          
      - name: Validate built plugins
        run: |
          # Check that plugins directory exists and has expected structure
          if [ ! -d "plugins/ork" ]; then
            echo "Error: Built plugin directory not found"
            exit 1
          fi
          
          # Verify no symlinks exist in built plugins
          if find plugins -type l | grep -q .; then
            echo "Error: Symlinks found in built plugins"
            find plugins -type l
            exit 1
          fi
          
          # Validate plugin manifests
          for manifest in manifests/*.json; do
            if [ -f "$manifest" ]; then
              echo "Validating $manifest"
              node -e "require('$manifest')"
            fi
          done
      
      - name: Commit built plugins
        run: |
          git config --local user.email "action@github.com"
          git config --local user.name "GitHub Action"
          git add plugins/
          if git diff --cached --quiet; then
            echo "No changes to commit"
          else
            git commit -m "Build plugins [skip ci]"
            git push origin HEAD:main
          fi
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
      
      - name: Run tests
        run: npm test
```
